newsitem.title: INDIA: India's 20 bln rupee 10-year bond undersubscribed.
newsitem.headline: India's 20 bln rupee 10-year bond undersubscribed.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said a sale of 13.85 percent 10-year government bonds on Monday raised 9.68 billion rupees against the targeted 20 billion.
RBI said it accepted all 68 applications it received for a total of 9.68 billion rupees.
"The Reserve Bank of India and primary dealers have taken the balance amount to the extent of 9.24 billion rupees and 1.07 billion rupees respectively," it said in a statement.
